hardware.variant: One R4 LittleFS kit with the 480 × 480 CO5300 display.

inputs.name: Static RV32 ILP32 framebuffer-independent test executable
Static RV32 display executable
inputs.revision: EmberBSD QML built from the Qt source. SDK 978c00ee51269260c8b4f6687ebf228e4ea6c82b, Examples 2330aeddf12d170d159a10552fe6ae5131155528.

scenario: Compile the original Qt source with EmberBSD QML. Render the initial scene in a 320 × 240 viewport using RGB565 on the host and on the target CPU. Present the viewport centered on wsdisplay.
expected: Three top-aligned red rectangles, 50 × 50, 20 × 10 and 40 × 20 pixels, separated by 10 pixels on white.
observed: The RV32 CPU run matched the host Qt reference (RGB565 CRC32 2755e523). The display application presented the scene on ttyE0 and the operator identified all three rectangles. A separate host run with the initial boolean changed to true matched the Qt right-to-left reference (CRC32 44817ce7).
limits: The physical observation covers the initial left-to-right scene. The host compared both initial directions in separate builds.
The board ran the executables on the existing R4 system.
